lines: You have stood for this village, yet you wear the mark of those who would destroy it. <shake>Take it off.</shake>
Our trust in you does not make that raider mark harmless. Do not carry it through my home.
You should know what that banner promises to a village. Why would you put it above your own face?
I have no village to claim, but I know that mark. Your good name does not cleanse it.
I respect what you have done. I cannot respect the banner you chose to wear.
Even a wanderer knows what follows that pattern. Take it off before anyone mistakes your meaning.
We trusted you. Do not walk our streets wearing the mark of a village's enemies.
I know the person beneath that banner. That is why seeing you wear it feels like a warning.
You have friends here. Think about what that symbol says to every one of them.
I thought better of you. A raider's mark is not a trophy to wear among villagers.
I may belong nowhere, but I still know what that banner threatens. Why are you wearing it?
You earned my trust. Do not ask that trust to survive beneath that symbol.
That banner belongs over a raiding patrol, not in our streets. State your purpose.
You entered my village wearing the mark of those who attack villages. Explain yourself.
Take that symbol away from our bell. Until then, every word from you sounds like a threat.
I do not know you, but I know the banner above your face. Keep your distance.
No village claims me, and even I would not wear a raider's mark among villagers.
That pattern has emptied homes before. Tell me why you chose to display it.
I already doubted your intentions. That banner makes them look much clearer.
So that is the side you want my village to see. Do not come any closer.
Suspicion was caution before you wore that mark through our streets. Now it is common sense.
I had reasons not to trust you. You put the strongest one on your head.
A wanderer learns which signs mean danger. Yours is impossible to miss.
You wear a raider's threat openly and still expect conversation? Speak from there.
That mark confirms what this village already knows about you. Leave.
You wear our enemies' banner as if you want the whole village to understand your intent.
I needed no more reason to oppose you. You brought one anyway, stitched in black and gray.
I trusted you before I saw the banner even less than I do now.
A raider's mark suits the reputation you have made for yourself.
Keep that symbol and your excuses away from me.
<shake>That banner...</shake> You know what it means to my village. Please, do not come closer.
Everyone here already fears you. Wearing that mark makes it feel like a promise.
Please take it off. I cannot see it above your face and believe this conversation is safe.
<shake>I know that mark.</shake> I know you. Please stay back.
I have survived by leaving when I see signs like yours. Say what you want quickly.
The banner makes your reputation visible from far away. I wish I had seen it sooner.
